description: KNOWN UNSUPPORTED: `meta.subscribe(…)` in a runtime `^{…}` meta block (§22.5.1) — the bootstrap front end refuses it by name with E-BOOTSTRAP-UNSUPPORTED (s482-meta-runtime: runtime `^{}` is built, `meta.subscribe` is not yet). (s481-boot-meta: was any runtime `^{}`.) (s469-boot-css: was a `#{…}` CSS block, which the bootstrap now compiles.)
